profile.headline: Software Engineering at Boeing
profile.summary:
Over 20 years in software development firm. Strong background in Web-based and Window Application. Equipped with teamwork, leadership, high self-confidence, strong analytical skills, flexibility, and communication skills. 

Seeking a position in .NET Application Engineer or Architect that provides challenges and advancement opportunities, where I will be able to utilize my skills and contribute to the success of the company.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Lead software development team to develop applications to support Electrical Technical Center
- Work with business team to Architect/Design solution
- Provides technical leadership and guidance to development team
- Point of communication to the Software Development Team
- Technology Stack: Entity Framework Core, GIT, Visual Studio, ASP.NET CORE, CI/CD, C#, REST API, Angular UI, Azure DevOps

positions.title: Sr. IT Development Specialist
positions.description:
- Continuous development of existing and improve or expanding systems
- Find creative ways to bridge the client-server gap using RESTful Services, OData, AJAX, and other available tools
- Asp.net Core, EF7, and Visual Studio 2017
- Aurelia(Angular like) and TypeScript to build Front End User Interfaces based on MVVM pattern
- Asp.net, C#, Asp.net MVC, Web API, MicroServices
- Entity Framework Core, GIT, TFS 2017, ASP.NET CORE, JIRA, CI/CD, Azure DevOps

positions.title: Sr. Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Work with other engineers and developers to create AJAX enable web applications using ASP.NET MVC 3.0, 4.0, 5.0, and Web API

Leads and performs the design, program, test, implementation and documentation of complex computing applications and software or computing architecture and computing application system designs. 

Leads analysis of end user processes to define application requirements. Writes and compiles complex code based on documented design or designs application architecture that integrates application software and delivery subsystems for specific applications. 

Modifies or upgrades complex applications to maintain functionality and performance. Identifies and recommends improvements. 

Identifies and resolves complex programming or application architecture problems.

positions.title: Sr. Technology Consultant (Comsys LLC)
positions.description:
Work with other engineers and developers to create AJAX enable web applications using .NET 2.0.

Develop application to support 787 program include architect, design, code, test, and support.

Use Aspose Component to Export data to Word/Excel Document

Participate in technical reviews of feasibility studies and conduct design, documentation, implementation, and validation reviews.

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer
positions.description:
Research and Development new technology to fulfill the business needs.

Responsible for all phases of Software Life Cycle. Working with others Developers to define and migrates legacy system to .NET 2.0, Web Services, .NET Window Applications, and Window Services. 

Supporting and developing in house applications to improve daily business processes.

Partnered with other IT professionals to define and develop system solutions and produce quality results deliverables.

Supporting and Enhancement OCR application. This application using OCR technology to automated incoming Filing Acknowledgement. This application was developing in C#, VB.NET, and Web Services.

PGP Encryption to exchange data via Email and FTP.

Developed COM Add-In to open Internal Application from Outlook to display detail information

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Administration, Planning, Gather Information, Design, Development and Testing, Deployment, Management, Support, and Documentation in house applications.
Developing YMS (Yard Management System) Window Application to maintain the Containers transaction, written in C#. 
AS2 encryption to exchange EDI Data.
Testing RFID Technology for better inventory and tracking.
ASP.NET Web Application for clients to generate Excel/Crystal reports. C# Window Services that generates Excel report and generate PDF Invoices to send to clients.
Maintain and Develop new features for State-of-the-Art WMS application for real-time inventory, transactions, generating barcode for both internal use and clients, written in VB and SQL 2000.
Developed a Dashboard using ASP.NET (C#, www.myregal.biz) to provide real-time information to control the entire order cycle online, manage events, and workflow.
Centralize Reporting by using SQL Reporting Services.

positions.title: Inter. Web Developer Engineer
positions.description:
Research and Development ASP.NET.

Programming in ASP, HTML, and SQL to develop E-commerce enable web application.

Maintenance and develop new features.

educations.degreeName: Masters of Science in Computing and Software Systems

projects.title: Aurelia - SPA
projects.description:
Using Aurelia framework to construct SPA application. Aurelia is a client-side technology similar to Angular. 
This project is integrated with 3rd party API/Framework:
- IdentityServer4
- Google Map API
- Yelp API
